description: REQ-BILL-011 Acceptance Criteria lists the consumption ordering as: 'Consumption occurs after: Origin validation, link session validation, planId validation, inflight check, existing subscription check, Discord pre-check'. This omits 'advisory lock acquisition' and 'provisional member row creation' from the list, both of which occur between planId validation and inflight check per implementation-design-mvp.md section 5.1 steps 2-5. The ordering also omits step 3 (provisional member creation) which happens before step 4 (inflight check). An implementer following REQ-BILL-011 alone would not know that advisory lock and provisional member creation must precede the inflight operation check.

evidence.snippet: Consumption occurs after: Origin validation, link session validation, planId validation, inflight check, existing subscription check, Discord pre-check

sourceReference.snippet:
1. Origin / link_session / planId を検証
2. pg_advisory_xact_lock
3. members行仮作成
4. inflight_operation_* 残留チェック
5. 既存subscription チェック
6. Discord参加・権限検証
7. operationId保存
8. link_session消費

remediation: Update REQ-BILL-011 acceptance criteria to include the full ordered sequence: Origin validation -> link session validation -> planId validation -> advisory lock acquisition -> provisional member creation -> inflight check -> existing subscription check -> Discord pre-check -> operationId persistence -> link session consumption -> PAY.JP token verification -> PAY.JP writes.
